title: Matryoshka Hash Representations for Model-Aware Compact Semantic Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.07276v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) depends on dense retrieval: each document is stored as a learned vector, and a query is answered by finding its nearest neighbors in that vector space. Keeping one full-precision vector per document is the dominant index cost at corpus scale, so retrieval systems replace each vector with a short code of a few bytes---a step called quantization. Standard quantizers such as product quantization (PQ) pick the code that reconstructs the original vector most closely.   A single code is even more useful if it serves several byte budgets at once: when its short prefixes are each directly searchable, a deployment can set its efficiency--quality operating point without re-encoding the corpus. But training all prefixes under one objective makes the early bits a compromise across budgets---short codes improve while the full-width code degrades. translated_title: 面向模型感知紧凑语义检索的俄罗斯套娃哈希表示
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）依赖于稠密检索：每篇文档被存储为一个学习到的向量，查询通过在该向量空间中寻找最近邻来得到回答。在语料库规模下，为每篇文档保存一个全精度向量是索引的主要开销，因此检索系统将每个向量替换为几字节的短编码——这一步称为量化。标准的量化器（如乘积量化 PQ）会选择最能重构原始向量的编码。如果一个编码能同时服务多个字节预算，它将更加有用：当它的各个短前缀均可直接检索时，部署方无需重新编码整个语料库即可设定效率与质量的工作点。但在单一目标下训练所有前缀，会使得前面的比特成为多个预算之间的折中——短编码性能提升的同时，全宽编码的性能却会下降。量化到低位表示（如二进制编码），进一步……
tldr: 该论文提出俄罗斯套娃式哈希表示，使同一个压缩编码的各长度前缀均可直接检索，从而让检索系统无需重新编码语料库就能灵活地在不同字节预算下切换效率与质量的权衡点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Matryoshka hash representations whose prefixes are each directly searchable, allowing retrieval systems to flexibly adjust efficiency-quality operating points across byte budgets without re-encoding the corpus.
